papers.title: Dex-One2Many: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Human Demonstration
papers.translated_title: Dex-One2Many：从单个人类演示中学习灵巧操作
papers.author: Jusuk Lee
papers.summary: While learning dexterous manipulation from a single human video offers a promising alternative to costly robot demonstrations, many recent methods predominantly imitate demonstrated motions. Such strict motion matching often limits generalization to initial object poses, goal poses, and grasps not shown in the video. Alternatively, discovering a policy via reinforcement learning (RL) allows for broad generalization, but without prior guidance, it struggles with high-dimensional exploration in complex, multi-stage tasks. To address these coupled generalization and exploration challenges, we present Dex-One2Many, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that learns a generalizable dexterous manipulation policy from a single human video. Our key insight is to abstract the video into sequential scene graphs that guide RL, enabling efficient exploration while preserving broad generalizability. The graphs serve as generative constraints for sampling diverse reset states and provide dense rewards for each stage. Because the graphs constrain relations rather than exact poses, these reset states cover object poses and grasps beyond the video, while initializing each stage from them with dense rewards keeps exploration short and guided. Trained entirely in simulation, Dex-One2Many transfers zero-shot to a real multi-fingered hand. Across five tool-use and manipulation tasks, Dex-One2Many exceeds baselines by 6.5% in seen configurations, while its robust generalization widens this gap to 71% in unseen scenarios.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管从单个人类视频中学习灵巧操作提供了一种有望替代昂贵机器人演示的方案，但近期许多方法主要模仿演示动作。这种严格的运动匹配往往限制了对视频中未出现的初始物体位姿、目标位姿和抓取的泛化能力。另一种方案是通过强化学习（RL）发现策略，这允许广泛的泛化，但缺乏先验指导时，在高维多阶段复杂任务中难以进行有效探索。为解决泛化与探索这两大耦合挑战，我们提出 Dex-One2Many，一个从真实到仿真再到真实的框架，能够从单个人类视频中学习可泛化的灵巧操作策略。我们的核心洞见是将视频抽象为序列化场景图，用以指导强化学习，从而在保持广泛泛化能力的同时实现高效探索。这些图作为生成性约束，用于采样多样化的重置状态，并为每个阶段提供密集奖励。由于图约束的是关系而非精确位姿，这些重置状态覆盖了视频之外的物体位姿和抓取，同时从这些状态初始化每个阶段并配合密集奖励，使探索过程保持简短且受引导。Dex-One2Many 完全在仿真中训练，并零样本迁移至真实多指手。在五项工具使用与操作任务中，Dex-One2Many 在已见配置上超越基线 6.5%，而其稳健的泛化能力在未见场景中将这一差距扩大至 71%。

papers.title: Rubric-CEPR: Self-Evolving Image Editing via Reward-Verified Self-Distillation
papers.translated_title: 评分标准-CEPR：通过奖励验证的自蒸馏实现自进化图像编辑
papers.author: Ritesh Thawkar
papers.summary: Instruction-guided image editors have become highly capable, yet improving them further still depends on human-edited training pairs or external reward models. Such supervision is costly to obtain and can reward plausible failures: a realistic output may leave the requested change undone or alter content that should be preserved. In this work, we strive to improve a pretrained image editor using only its own generations, without human-edited targets or an external training-time reward model. To this end, we propose a self-evolving framework, named Rubric-CEPR, that verifies the editor's own samples with its internal representations through a rubric-augmented Contrastive Edit-Preservation Reward (CEPR). A Planner proposes structured edit instructions from unlabeled images, the Editor samples multiple candidate edits, and a frozen Critic scores each candidate with decomposed rubric checks for edit realization, removal of the old state, and content preservation, using features already exposed by the editor. Non-compensatory gates reject infeasible candidates, and the best verified candidate is distilled into the editor through lightweight adapter training. On Qwen-Image-Edit, Rubric-CEPR improves ImgEdit from 4.36 to 4.60 (+5.5%), with a +24.9% gain on object isolation, and transfers to GEdit-Bench and Complex-Edit. The same procedure also improves Step1X-Edit by +7.8% on ImgEdit. We hope our approach will serve as a solid baseline for image editors that improve themselves from their own verified samples. Our code is publicly available at $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/}{\text{this URL}}$
papers.translated_summary: 指令引导的图像编辑器已变得非常强大，但进一步提升它们仍然依赖于人工编辑的训练对或外部奖励模型。这类监督获取成本高昂，并且可能奖励看似合理的失败：一个逼真的输出可能并未完成所请求的修改，或者改变了本应保留的内容。在这项工作中，我们致力于仅使用预训练图像编辑器自身的生成结果来改进它，而不依赖人工编辑的目标或外部训练时奖励模型。为此，我们提出了一个自演化框架，名为 Rubric-CEPR，它通过一个由评分标准增强的对比编辑-保留奖励（CEPR），利用编辑器自身的内部表示来验证其自身样本。一个 Planner 从未标注图像中提出结构化编辑指令，Editor 采样多个候选编辑，一个冻结的 Critic 使用编辑器已经暴露的特征，通过分解的评分标准检查对每个候选进行评分，检查包括编辑实现、旧状态移除和内容保留。非补偿性门控拒绝不可行的候选，最佳验证候选通过轻量级适配器训练蒸馏到编辑器中。在 Qwen-Image-Edit 上，Rubric-CEPR 将 ImgEdit 从 4.36 提升到 4.60（+5.5%），在物体隔离上获得 +24.9% 的提升，并迁移到 GEdit-Bench 和 Complex-Edit。相同流程在 ImgEdit 上也将 Step1X-Edit 提升了 +7.8%。我们希望我们的方法能够为从自身验证样本中自我改进的图像编辑器提供一个坚实的基线。我们的代码公开于 $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/}{\text{this URL}}$

papers.title: DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training
papers.translated_title: DreamTrue：具有反事实后训练的动作忠实机器人世界模型
papers.author: Junyan Li
papers.summary: We present DreamTrue, a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model for action-faithful and physically plausible video prediction. Training such a model on existing robot datasets faces two obstacles: imprecise calibration can impair action following, while limited coverage of unsuccessful interactions can bias predictions toward successful outcomes. To improve action following across embodiments, we render action trajectories into image-space conditions and introduce offline geometric calibration to align these conditions with the target videos. To broaden interaction coverage, we introduce counterfactual post-training, modifying recorded action trajectories and generating future videos under a wider range of actions and contact configurations. To provide feedback on these predictions without paired ground-truth futures, we construct a human-annotated video dataset covering robot, object, and interaction defects and use it to train an embodied video reward model. Its scores guide reinforcement-learning post-training toward more physically plausible interaction outcomes. On AgiBot, DreamTrue attains state-of-the-art action following, while reducing the human-assessed interaction defect rate from from 48.12% to 6.25%. Notably, our model ranks first in the world model track of the AgiBot World Challenge 2026. The project page can be found at https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue.
papers.translated_summary: 我们提出了DreamTrue，一个多视角、跨本体的机器人世界模型，用于动作忠实且物理合理的视频预测。在现有机器人数据集上训练此类模型面临两个障碍：不精确的标定可能损害动作跟随能力，而对失败交互的覆盖有限可能使预测偏向成功结果。为提升跨本体的动作跟随能力，我们将动作轨迹渲染为图像空间条件，并引入离线几何标定以使这些条件与目标视频对齐。为拓宽交互覆盖范围，我们引入了反事实后训练，修改记录的动作轨迹并在更广泛的动作与接触配置下生成未来视频。为在没有配对真实未来视频的情况下对这些预测提供反馈，我们构建了一个人工标注的视频数据集，涵盖机器人、物体和交互缺陷，并用其训练具身视频奖励模型。其评分引导强化学习后训练朝向更物理合理的交互结果。在AgiBot上，DreamTrue达到了最先进的动作跟随性能，同时将人工评估的交互缺陷率从48.12%降低至6.25%。值得注意的是，我们的模型在AgiBot World Challenge 2026的世界模型赛道中排名第一。项目页面见https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue。

papers.title: CSF: Contextual Safety Filtering for Motion Generators
papers.translated_title: CSF：面向运动生成器的上下文安全过滤
papers.author: Lizhi Yang
papers.summary: Text-conditioned motion generators produce trackable whole-body motion, but they have no notion of scene-dependent safety: the same action may target an object or a person. Existing safeguards either inspect the prompt, require labeled motion data, or enforce geometric constraints; therefore, they do not directly account for how scene context changes a motion's meaning. We introduce contextual safety filtering (CSF), a training-free filter that grounds natural-language safety rules in safe and unsafe reference trajectories produced by the generator. For each active rule, safe and unsafe reference trajectories define an affine safety value that a safe reference tracking CBF-QP enforces. Across four pretrained generators with different architectures, CSF activates the intended rules in all explicit and scene-triggered unsafe cases and reduces the danger-event rate by up to 90%, while preserving 88-100% of benign motions. We demonstrate the complete system on a real-world Unitree G1, where it successfully prevents unsafe motions in a variety of scenarios, including interactions with humans and objects.
papers.translated_summary: 文本条件运动生成器能够生成可跟踪的全身运动，但它们没有场景相关的安全概念：同一动作可能以物体或人为目标。现有的防护措施要么检查提示词，要么需要标注的运动数据，要么施加几何约束；因此，它们无法直接考虑场景上下文如何改变运动的含义。我们引入了上下文安全过滤（CSF），这是一种无需训练即可使用的过滤器，它将自然语言安全规则建立在生成器产生的安全与不安全参考轨迹之上。对于每条激活规则，安全与不安全参考轨迹定义了一个仿射安全值，由安全参考跟踪CBF-QP强制执行。在四种具有不同架构的预训练生成器上，CSF在所有显式和场景触发的不安全案例中激活了预期规则，并将危险事件率降低多达90%，同时保留88-100%的良性运动。我们在真实的Unitree G1上展示了完整系统，它成功地在各种场景中防止了不安全运动，包括与人和物体的交互。

papers.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
papers.translated_title: 关于AI时间跨度的估计与有效性——对METR图表的统计学审视
papers.author: Drew T. Nguyen
papers.summary: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. On 228 tasks and 26 AIs, we recompute the time horizons using splines and item-response theory to relax the assumption that the AI difficulty of a task depends linearly on the log of human time. Our fitted spline can be interpreted as a function that \emph{converts} human time to AI difficulty; it is nearly flat in a region from 2--30 min but close to linear elsewhere. Hence, a time-horizon jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than one from 30 min to 5 hours despite the same multiplier of $10 \times$. Overall, we contribute time-horizon point estimates that perform better under a cross-validated suite of proper scoring rules, as well as diagnostic plots for assessing time horizons' construct validity. We suggest that time horizons be interpreted together with the diagnostic plots, especially as new time-horizon-based benchmarks are proposed or existing ones grow to include longer tasks.
papers.translated_summary: METR的50%时间视界衡量的是AI以50%概率解决的软件任务的人类完成时间，从而使AI能力能够以可解释的单位来表达。在228个任务和26个AI上，我们使用样条和项目反应理论重新计算时间视界，以放宽任务对AI的难度线性依赖于人类时间对数的假设。我们拟合的样条可以解释为一个将人类时间\emph{转换}为AI难度的函数；它在2至30分钟的区域几乎平坦，但在其他地方接近线性。因此，尽管倍数同为$10 \times$，从3分钟到30分钟的时间视界跃升比从30分钟到5小时的跃升容易得多。总体而言，我们贡献了在交叉验证的适当评分规则套件下表现更好的时间视界点估计，以及用于评估时间视界构念效度的诊断图。我们建议将时间视界与诊断图一起解读，尤其是在新的基于时间视界的基准被提出或现有基准扩展到包含更长任务时。

papers.title: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control
papers.translated_title: 平衡数据饮食：解决机器人控制中大规模强化学习的探索瓶颈
papers.author: Octi Zhang
papers.summary: General-purpose robots must perform a wide range of tasks from agile locomotion to dexterous manipulation. While sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has proven to be a useful tool for this goal, current RL pipelines depend on engineering-heavy, per-task structural priors such as shaped rewards and demonstrations. Recent work has shown that diverse simulator resets, combined with massively parallel simulation, can alleviate much of this engineering burden on several manipulation problems. However, we find that naively scaling this paradigm to more precise or dynamic problems remains non-trivial. While simulator resets can help with exploration, uniformly sampling over this distribution wastes a growing fraction of learning experience on task configurations the policy has already mastered or cannot yet attempt. This makes it challenging to see the expected benefits of scaling parallel environments for RL, since much of the learning signal in a batch is wasted during learning. To mitigate this, we introduce Success Guided Sampling (SGS), a simple adaptive sampler that concentrates RL training on task configurations around the frontier of the policy's capabilities. Doing so allows large-scale simulated RL to make the most out of the experience in a batch, enabling much more effective scaling to large-scale parallel simulation. Across experiments using up to $2^{20}$ (over one million) parallel environments, SGS enables RL to solve challenging multi-terrain quadruped locomotion and contact-rich assembly tasks that prior methods fail to solve. Finally, we distill the learned manipulation policies into RGB-based policies and demonstrate zero-shot transfer to several challenging assembly tasks on real hardware. Project website: https://sgs-rl.github.io/.
papers.translated_summary: 通用机器人必须执行从敏捷运动到灵巧操作的各种任务。尽管仿真到现实的强化学习已被证明是实现这一目标的有用工具，但当前的强化学习流程依赖于工程繁重、针对每个任务的结构化先验，例如塑形奖励和演示。近期工作表明，多样化的模拟器重置结合大规模并行仿真，可以减轻若干操作问题上的大量工程负担。然而，我们发现，将这一范式简单地扩展到更精确或更动态的问题仍然并非易事。虽然模拟器重置有助于探索，但在该分布上均匀采样会将越来越大比例的学习经验浪费在策略已经掌握或尚无法尝试的任务配置上。这使得难以看到为强化学习扩展并行环境所带来的预期收益，因为批次中的大量学习信号在学习过程中被浪费。为缓解这一问题，我们引入了成功引导采样，一种简单的自适应采样器，它将强化学习训练集中在策略能力前沿附近的任务配置上。这样做使大规模仿真强化学习能够充分利用批次中的经验，从而更有效地扩展到大规模并行仿真。在使用多达$2^{20}$（超过一百万）个并行环境的实验中，成功引导采样使强化学习能够解决此前方法无法解决的具有挑战性的多地形四足运动任务和接触丰富的装配任务。最后，我们将学习到的操作策略蒸馏为基于RGB的策略，并展示了在真实硬件上对若干具有挑战性的装配任务的零样本迁移。项目网站：https://sgs-rl.github.io/。

papers.title: From Reactive Containment to Proactive Assurance: Lessons from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Agent Security Incidents
papers.translated_title: 从被动遏制到主动保障：来自OpenAI、Anthropic和Google智能体安全事件的教训
papers.author: Abbas Raftari
papers.summary: In 2026, cybersecurity evaluations involving OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google agents reached real systems outside their authorized test scope. The paths were different. OpenAI agents exploited research infrastructure, coordinated across runs, and compromised parts of Hugging Face's production environment. Anthropic reported cases in which a misconfigured third-party environment exposed real systems to agents pursuing simulated cyber tasks. In a separately reported evaluation, Google's Gemini accessed three real organizations through an unintended internet route; Google stated that the model stopped in all three instances. Taken together, the cases show why an evaluation cannot rely on an assumed boundary. That boundary must be verified while the agent is operating. This comparative instrumental case study develops a Proactive Agent Security Assurance Cycle (PASAC) and a five-layer Boundary Assurance Stack. The framework combines risk-tiered task design, executable scope contracts, pre-run validation, least-capability access, independent egress enforcement, credential restrictions, cross-run monitoring, automatic stop conditions, and evidence-based reauthorization. A leading-indicator model, nine design propositions, and seven falsifiable hypotheses turn these lessons into a testable research program. Because the public Gemini record is limited to attributed statements and journalism, its detailed causal mechanism remains provisional. The central conclusion is straightforward: proactive agent security requires continuous assurance across the full execution system, not confidence in any single sandbox or safeguard.
papers.translated_summary: 2026年，涉及OpenAI、Anthropic和Google智能体的网络安全评估触及了其授权测试范围之外的真实系统。路径各不相同。OpenAI的智能体利用了研究基础设施，跨运行进行协调，并侵入了Hugging Face生产环境的部分区域。Anthropic报告了多起案例，其中配置错误的第三方环境将真实系统暴露给了执行模拟网络任务的智能体。在另一项单独报告的评估中，Google的Gemini通过一条非预期的互联网路径访问了三家真实组织；Google表示该模型在三次实例中均停止了操作。综合来看，这些案例表明评估为何不能依赖假定的边界。该边界必须在智能体运行期间得到验证。本比较性工具性案例研究提出了主动式智能体安全保障周期（PASAC）和五层边界保障栈。该框架结合了风险分级任务设计、可执行范围契约、运行前验证、最小能力访问、独立出口管控、凭证限制、跨运行监控、自动停止条件以及基于证据的重新授权。一个先行指标模型、九项设计命题和七项可证伪假设将这些经验转化为可测试的研究议程。由于公开的Gemini记录仅限于归属声明和新闻报道，其详细因果机制仍属暂定。核心结论直截了当：主动式智能体安全需要在完整执行系统中实现持续保障，而非依赖对任何单一沙箱或防护措施的信任。

papers.title: What 30,000 Hours of Ego-centric Video Does Not Teach
papers.translated_title: 3万小时的自我中心视频无法教会什么
papers.author: Jiahua Dong
papers.summary: World models offer a promising alternative to physics-based simulators, yet remain far from practical deployment. We ask how far scaling ego-centric human video takes them, using a dataset of 30,000 hours spanning over 1,000 scene types and 14,000 contributors. Rather than relying on opaque downstream metrics, we directly evaluate agent and object-interaction fidelity on a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark. Increasing training data by 100x improves both, but unevenly: the agent is modeled well, while object fidelity remains far lower and improves slowly. We show that the agent gains need not come from data, and a careful visual conditioning design saturates fidelity with a fraction of it, which lets us measure object fidelity on its own and discover its saturation point. We then introduce a supervision scheme that shifts capacity from scene appearance toward object dynamics, improving object fidelity though a substantial gap remains. Finally, our conclusions transfer to downstream humanoid modeling. Overall, our results suggest that scaling ego-centric data brings agent modeling close to its limit while leaving its effects on the world far behind, and that closing this gap will depend on how models are trained, not only on how much data they see.
papers.translated_summary: 世界模型为基于物理的模拟器提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但距离实际部署仍很遥远。我们探究，以自我为中心的人类视频扩展到何种程度才能推动世界模型走向实用，为此使用了一个包含3万小时、涵盖1000多种场景类型和14000名贡献者的数据集。我们没有依赖不透明的下游指标，而是直接在一个具有挑战性的分布外基准上评估智能体和物体交互的保真度。将训练数据扩大100倍对两者都有改善，但程度不均：智能体被建模得很好，而物体保真度仍然低得多且改善缓慢。我们表明，智能体的提升未必来自数据，而一个精心的视觉条件设计能以一小部分数据使保真度饱和，这使我们能够单独测量物体保真度并发现其饱和点。随后我们引入一种监督方案，将容量从场景外观转向物体动态，改善了物体保真度，尽管仍有相当大的差距。最后，我们的结论可迁移至下游的人形建模。总体而言，我们的结果表明，扩展以自我为中心的数据使智能体建模接近其极限，却使其对世界的影响远远落后，而弥合这一差距将取决于模型如何被训练，而不仅仅是它们看到多少数据。

papers.title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
papers.translated_title: OuroWorld：将任意3D世界变为多样、无限循环的3D动态摄影
papers.author: You-Zhe Xie
papers.summary: Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video, which we lift and complete into multi-view videos. To learn from this imperfect supervision, we propose Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS: a Fourier-series deformation field guarantees looping by construction, while a Grounded Drift Field anchored at the reference view absorbs cross-view inconsistency. Unlike prior Eulerian methods limited to fluid-like motion, we capture general deformation, object motion, and illumination change. We introduce a ground-truth-free evaluation covering vividness, naturalness, loop seam coherence, and scene quality. On 39 reconstructed and generated scenes, OuroWorld outperforms all baselines and wins 70.8%-99.0% of user-study comparisons. Project page: https://ouroworld.userwei.com
papers.translated_summary: 近期的3D世界模型能够生成照片级真实、可探索的场景，但这些场景在时间上是冻结的。OuroWorld是一个无需掩码的框架，可将任何静态3D高斯泼溅场景转化为3D动态摄影图：一种具有生动、多样运动且能从任意视角无缝循环的动态场景。一个视觉语言模型推断合理的动态并引导视频模型合成参考视频，我们将其提升并补全为多视角视频。为了从这种不完美的监督中学习，我们提出了不一致性鲁棒周期性4DGS：一个傅里叶级数变形场通过构造保证循环性，而一个锚定在参考视图的接地漂移场吸收跨视图不一致性。与先前仅限于类流体运动的欧拉方法不同，我们捕捉一般变形、物体运动和光照变化。我们引入了一种无需真值的评估，涵盖生动性、自然性、循环接缝连贯性和场景质量。在39个重建和生成的场景上，OuroWorld优于所有基线，并在70.8%-99.0%的用户研究比较中获胜。项目页面：https://ouroworld.userwei.com

papers.title: WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution
papers.translated_title: WorldGuide：面向程序化任务执行的目标导向视频世界模型
papers.author: Ankan Deria
papers.summary: Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced. A model must determine the next action from its generated state, execute that action, and recognize when the task is complete. Open-loop generation cannot adapt to execution outcomes, while existing closed-loop systems often rely on pretrained executors or indirect verification. This leaves a gap between deciding an action and successfully realizing it. We formulate procedural video generation as \emph{closed-loop task execution in visual world space} and introduce \textbf{WorldGuide}. Given only an initial image and a task goal, WorldGuide predicts an atomic action, generates its corresponding video clip, and uses the generated result to select the next action or terminate. The Planner and Executor are trained on the same step-level procedural demonstrations: the Planner learns to predict the next atomic action or task completion from visual progress, while the Executor is directly trained to realize the predicted actions. Hierarchical visual memory maintains state across long-horizon execution with bounded history token cost. Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce \textbf{WorldGuide Bench}: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. WorldGuide achieves a 33.33\% Task Success on \textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}, compared with 29.90\% for the strong recent video model MiniMax-H3, even though MiniMax-H3 receives reference action plans, and achieves 47.69\% on \textbf{VideoCraft-Bench} compared with 32.73\% for MiniMax-H3 under goal-only conditioning. These results demonstrate the importance of coupling planning with learned execution for goal-directed procedural video generation.
papers.translated_summary: 视频生成器和基于视频的世界模型能够合成看似合理的视觉轨迹，但长时程程序性任务要求生成过程能够适应实际产生的结果。模型必须根据其生成的状态确定下一步动作，执行该动作，并识别任务何时完成。开环生成无法适应执行结果，而现有的闭环系统往往依赖预训练执行器或间接验证。这在决定动作与成功实现动作之间留下了差距。我们将程序性视频生成形式化为\emph{视觉世界空间中的闭环任务执行}，并提出了\textbf{WorldGuide}。仅给定初始图像和任务目标，WorldGuide预测一个原子动作，生成其对应的视频片段，并利用生成结果选择下一步动作或终止。规划器和执行器在相同的步骤级程序性演示上进行训练：规划器学习从视觉进展中预测下一个原子动作或任务完成，而执行器则被直接训练以实现所预测的动作。分层视觉记忆在有界历史令牌成本下维持长时程执行中的状态。由于缺乏用于联合规划器-执行器训练的步骤级动作-视频监督，我们引入了\textbf{WorldGuide Bench}：约59K个步骤标注视频，涵盖245个任务和27个程序性类别。WorldGuide在\textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}上实现了33.33\%的任务成功率，而近期强视频模型MiniMax-H3为29.90\%，尽管MiniMax-H3接收了参考动作计划；在\textbf{VideoCraft-Bench}上实现了47.69\%，而在仅目标条件下MiniMax-H3为32.73\%。这些结果证明了将规划与学习到的执行相耦合对于目标导向的程序性视频生成的重要性。

papers.title: Bovine H5N1 influenza viruses have adapted to more efficiently use receptors abundant in cattle
papers.translated_title: 牛H5N1流感病毒已适应更高效地利用牛体内丰富的受体
papers.author: Hassard, J. A.
papers.summary: Sustained mammal-to-mammal transmission of high pathogenicity H5N1 avian influenza viruses is reshaping the host range of these pathogens. One of the longest-running mammalian transmission chains involves the B3.13 genotype circulating in U.S. dairy cattle which was detected in early 2024. Genomic analyses revealed selection and rapid fixation of haemagglutinin mutations D104G and V147M. We demonstrate, via glycomic profiling, that bovine tissues, including the mammary gland, are enriched in N- and O-linked glycans capped with N-glycolylneuraminic acid (NeuGc), a sialic acid which is not synthesised by humans and birds, which instead express only N-acetylneuraminic acid (NeuAc). Early cattle H5 viruses poorly recognised NeuGc, but D104G and V147M enabled efficient engagement of both NeuAc- and NeuGc-containing receptors. These mutations enhanced replication in bovine mammary tissue without major attenuation of replication in human lung and primary nasal epithelial cells. NeuGc-driven receptor adaptation therefore promotes viral fitness in cattle without majorly changing zoonotic risk. Deep mutational scanning was able to identify alternative haemagglutinin substitutions that confer NeuGc usage and represent surveillance markers for emerging cattle H5 lineages. Finally, structural analyses suggest a potential molecular mechanism for the dual binding of the cattle-adapted viruses.
papers.translated_summary: 高致病性H5N1禽流感病毒的持续哺乳动物间传播正在重塑这些病原体的宿主范围。其中持续时间最长的哺乳动物传播链之一涉及2024年初在美国奶牛中检测到的B3.13基因型。基因组分析揭示了血凝素突变D104G和V147M的选择和快速固定。我们通过糖组学分析证明，牛组织（包括乳腺）富含以N-羟乙酰神经氨酸（NeuGc）封端的N-连接和O-连接聚糖，这是一种人类和鸟类不合成的唾液酸，它们仅表达N-乙酰神经氨酸（NeuAc）。早期牛H5病毒对NeuGc识别能力较差，但D104G和V147M使其能够高效结合含NeuAc和NeuGc的受体。这些突变增强了在牛乳腺组织中的复制，而未显著减弱在人肺和原代鼻上皮细胞中的复制。因此，NeuGc驱动的受体适应促进了病毒在牛体内的适应性，而未大幅改变人畜共患风险。深度突变扫描能够识别赋予NeuGc利用能力的替代性血凝素替换，这些可作为新兴牛H5谱系的监测标志物。最后，结构分析提出了牛适应病毒双重结合的潜在分子机制。

papers.title: Inflammation-driven cellular selection impacts X-linked mosaicism in the epidermis
papers.translated_title: 炎症驱动的细胞选择影响表皮中X连锁嵌合现象
papers.author: Angelopoulou, E.
papers.summary: In eutherian females, the choice of which X chromosome gets embryonically inactivated is thought to be random. Somatic tissues are thus assumed to comprise cells with a 50:50 ratio of maternal:paternal X active. However, a phenomenon known as X-skewing has been observed, wherein tissue composition shifts to be dominated by cells expressing one X or the other. On a gross level, such X-skewing is phenotypically silent except in the case where one X-chromosome carries a disease mutation. Here, by leveraging a mouse model of an X-linked disease called Incontinentia Pigmenti, caused by heterozygous mutations in the NF-kB effector, Nemo, we explore how X-linked cellular dynamics shape progenitor biology in the epidermis. Lineage tracing with X-linked reporters shows that at birth, the epidermis is unexpectedly skewed toward mutant cells. Within a week, as inflammation emerges, these dynamics reverse leaving surviving animals with almost entirely wild-type epithelium. The shift is driven by loss rather than growth since mutant cells adopt an aberrant fate and die at higher rates than their wild-type neighbours; proliferation rises in both populations. Notably, wild-type proliferation scales with local tissue composition, suggesting these cells calibrate their response to the extent of the mutant burden to compensate appropriately for tissue loss. Depleting macrophages, the principal TNF- source, attenuates inflammation, mutant cell death and ultimately is expected to preserve the mutant population. Altogether, our results identify inflammation as a selective force capable of resolving deleterious mosaicism, not only in the context of an X-linked disease, but within any dynamic, clonally heterogeneous epithelium.
papers.translated_summary: 在真兽亚纲雌性中，哪条X染色体在胚胎期失活被认为是随机的。因此，体细胞组织被假定由母源与父源X染色体活性比例为50:50的细胞组成。然而，人们观察到一种称为X偏斜的现象，即组织组成发生偏移，由表达某一条X染色体的细胞占主导。在宏观层面上，这种X偏斜在表型上是沉默的，除非其中一条X染色体携带疾病突变。在此，我们利用一种名为色素失禁症的X连锁疾病的小鼠模型，该病由NF-kB效应因子Nemo的杂合突变引起，来探索X连锁的细胞动力学如何塑造表皮中的祖细胞生物学。使用X连锁报告基因进行的谱系追踪显示，在出生时，表皮出乎意料地偏向突变细胞。在一周内，随着炎症出现，这些动力学发生逆转，使存活的动物拥有几乎完全为野生型的上皮。这一转变是由丢失而非生长驱动的，因为突变细胞采用异常命运，并比其野生型邻居以更高频率死亡；两个群体的增殖均上升。值得注意的是，野生型增殖随局部组织组成而变化，表明这些细胞根据突变负担的程度校准其反应，以适当补偿组织损失。耗竭巨噬细胞——主要的TNF来源——可减轻炎症、突变细胞死亡，并最终预计会保留突变群体。总之，我们的结果确定炎症是一种能够解决有害嵌合的选择性力量，不仅在X连锁疾病的背景下如此，在任何动态的、克隆异质性的上皮中也是如此。

papers.title: Contrasting relationships between evolved consumer diversity and productivity for essential vs. substitutable resources
papers.translated_title: 进化消费者多样性与生产力之间的关系在必需资源与可替代资源之间的对比
papers.author: Gopakumar, A.
papers.summary: Any mechanistic biodiversity-ecosystem functioning theory must explain how biodiversity in natural communities arises, which requires an evolutionary metacommunity perspective. Using a model of adaptive evolution of competitive metacommunities in landscapes with spatially heterogeneous supply of two resources, we studied the evolution of resource-uptake specialization as a function of resource type (substitutable/essential) and trade-off shape between resource-uptake affinities (generalist-/specialist-favouring). We identified "critical essentiality" as a key phenomenon separating parameter regions with fundamentally different biodiversity--ecosystem function relationships. Specifically, while greater spatial heterogeneity in resource supply increases biodiversity, this comes at the cost of reduced productivity when resources are essential. Moreover, when resources are essential, both generalist- and specialist-favoring trade-offs select for phenotypes that prevent efficient resource partitioning, leading to low resource use efficiency and consumer biomass - despite often high species richness. In contrast, when resources are substitutable, a specialist-favoring affinity trade-off selects for phenotypes that partition resources efficiently, promoting a metacommunity of only two species characterized by high functional diversity, resource use efficiency, and biomass. Overall, our analyses thus suggest that conditions promoting the evolution of diverse consumer communities often do not engender higher functional richness, consumer biomass, or resource use efficiency.
papers.translated_summary: 任何机制性的生物多样性-生态系统功能理论都必须解释自然群落中的生物多样性是如何产生的，这需要一种进化集合群落视角。利用一个在两种资源供给具有空间异质性的景观中竞争性集合群落适应性进化的模型，我们研究了资源摄取特化随资源类型（可替代/必需）以及资源摄取亲和力之间权衡形状（偏向通用者/偏向专化者）的进化。我们识别出“临界必需性”作为一个关键现象，它将具有根本不同生物多样性-生态系统功能关系的参数区域区分开来。具体而言，尽管资源供给的空间异质性越大，生物多样性越高，但当资源为必需资源时，这是以生产力降低为代价的。此外，当资源为必需资源时，偏向通用者和偏向专化者的权衡都会选择阻止有效资源分配的性状，导致资源利用效率和消费者生物量低下——尽管物种丰富度往往很高。相比之下，当资源为可替代资源时，偏向专化者的亲和力权衡会选择有效分配资源的性状，促进一个仅由两个物种组成的集合群落，其特征是高功能多样性、资源利用效率和生物量。总体而言，我们的分析因此表明，促进多样化消费者群落进化的条件往往并不会带来更高的功能丰富度、消费者生物量或资源利用效率。

papers.title: WildObserve: Camera-trap image review software that learns species labels during annotation
papers.translated_title: WildObserve：在标注过程中学习物种标签的红外相机图像审查软件
papers.author: Tabak, M.
papers.summary: Motion-activated camera traps are an effective tool for monitoring animals, but a single study can produce millions of images, which must be analyzed before they yield data. The burden of analyzing them has led many teams to automate the work with computer vision. These models lose accuracy on images unlike those they were trained on, however, and a general model may not use the categories a project needs. Adapting a model to a project usually requires at least one of the following: many labeled images per species, programming expertise, a graphics processing unit (GPU), or uploading images to a remote server. I describe WildObserve, a desktop application that adapts to each project without any of these requirements. Before a reviewer sees an image, MegaDetector finds animals, people, and vehicles and marks images that are likely empty, and SpeciesNet suggests a species for each animal. WildObserve keeps SpeciesNet's feature vector for each animal, so as the reviewer confirms or corrects labels, a project model (a logistic regression on those features) retrains in about a second on an ordinary laptop, learning the project's own species list and names. Images stay on the user's computer, model outputs and human decisions are kept separate, and exports record review and model provenance. On the Caltech Camera Traps dataset, WildObserve processed 8.1 images/s on an Apple M1 Pro laptop with Core ML (1.5 images/s on its CPU), species suggestions included. At a 0.5 threshold, it found animals in 97.1% of animal images but also put a box on 48.0% of images labeled empty. On 1,467 animal crops from 14 categories, SpeciesNet alone reached 0.919 balanced accuracy. The project model reached 0.886 with three labels per category and 0.937 with 25, and 0.931 on camera locations absent from its training labels; built on features from DINOv2, a general-purpose image model, it reached only 0.784 with 50. On the Oregon Critters dataset, released after SpeciesNet was trained, SpeciesNet reached 0.751 and the project model passed it with only ten labels per category (0.783). WildObserve gives a project species suggestions in its own categories, from a model it trains simply by reviewing, without writing code, needing a GPU, or sending images elsewhere.
papers.translated_summary: 运动触发的相机陷阱是监测动物的有效工具，但一项研究就可能产生数百万张图像，必须先分析这些图像才能获得数据。分析负担促使许多团队用计算机视觉来自动完成这项工作。然而，这些模型在与其训练图像不同的图像上会失去准确性，而且通用模型可能不使用项目所需的类别。要让模型适应某个项目，通常至少需要以下条件之一：每个物种大量标注图像、编程专业知识、图形处理单元（GPU），或将图像上传到远程服务器。我描述 WildObserve，这是一款无需任何上述要求即可适应每个项目的桌面应用程序。在审阅者看到图像之前，MegaDetector 会找出动物、人和车辆，并标记可能为空的图像，SpeciesNet 会为每只动物建议一个物种。WildObserve 保留 SpeciesNet 为每只动物生成的特征向量，因此当审阅者确认或纠正标签时，项目模型（对这些特征进行逻辑回归）会在普通笔记本电脑上约一秒内重新训练，学习项目自己的物种列表和名称。图像保留在用户计算机上，模型输出和人工决策分开保存，导出结果记录审阅和模型来源。在 Caltech Camera Traps 数据集上，WildObserve 在搭载 Core ML 的 Apple M1 Pro 笔记本电脑上以 8.1 张图像/秒的速度处理（其 CPU 上为 1.5 张图像/秒），包括物种建议。在 0.5 阈值下，它在 97.1% 的动物图像中找到了动物，但也在 48.0% 标记为空的图像上放置了框。在来自 14 个类别的 1,467 个动物裁剪图像上，仅 SpeciesNet 就达到了 0.919 的平衡准确率。项目模型在每个类别三个标签时达到 0.886，在 25 个标签时达到 0.937，在其训练标签中不存在的相机位置上达到 0.931；而基于 DINOv2（一个通用图像模型）的特征构建时，在 50 个标签下仅达到 0.784。在 SpeciesNet 训练之后发布的 Oregon Critters 数据集上，SpeciesNet 达到 0.751，而项目模型仅用每个类别十个标签就超过了它（0.783）。WildObserve 以项目自己的类别给出物种建议，所用模型仅通过审阅即可训练，无需编写代码、需要 GPU 或将图像发送到其他地方。

papers.title: Rapid trait adaptation has contrasting effects on different dimensions of stability under environmental change
papers.translated_title: 快速性状适应对环境变化下不同维度的稳定性产生对比性影响
papers.author: Holmes, M.
papers.summary: Environmental change alters species growth rates and, through species interactions, can produce complex effects on community functioning and composition. Because functional traits mediate both environmental responses and competition, rapid trait adaptation may modify these effects, but its consequences in multispecies communities remain unclear. We used a trait-based model of competitive communities to test how adaptation affects the mean and diversity of species growth responses to environmental change, and how this influences functional and compositional resistance (how unaffected the community is by the environmental change) and resilience (how well it recovers after it has acclimated to the altered environment). Adaptation altered response variance more strongly than the mean by changing the balance between environmental optimisation and competition-driven trait divergence. As a result, adaptation strongly increased compositional stability, but had less clear effects on abundance. Adaptation also generated a trade-off between resistance and resilience: faster adaptation improved resistance but reduced resilience as communities were displaced less by the environmental change and thus recovered less. Overall, adaptation can be stabilising, but higher adaptation rates do not necessarily produce greater stability across all stability components.
papers.translated_summary: 环境变化会改变物种的生长速率，并通过物种相互作用对群落功能和组成产生复杂影响。由于功能性状同时介导环境响应和竞争，快速的性状适应可能改变这些影响，但其在多物种群落中的后果仍不清楚。我们使用基于性状的竞争群落模型，检验适应如何影响物种对环境变化生长响应的均值和多样性，以及这如何影响功能和组成抗性（群落受环境变化影响的程度）和恢复力（群落在适应改变后的环境后恢复的程度）。适应通过改变环境优化与竞争驱动的性状分化之间的平衡，对响应方差的影响强于对均值的影响。因此，适应强烈提高了组成稳定性，但对多度的影响较不明确。适应还在抗性和恢复力之间产生了权衡：更快的适应提高了抗性，但降低了恢复力，因为群落因环境变化而发生的位移较小，因而恢复也较少。总体而言，适应可以具有稳定作用，但更高的适应速率并不一定在所有稳定性组分上都产生更大的稳定性。

papers.title: Compatible Comma-Free Codes and the Origin of the Genetic Code
papers.translated_title: 兼容的无逗号编码与遗传密码的起源
papers.author: Boyle, L.
papers.summary: The genetic code is the rule that (apart from minor modifications) is used by all contemporary life on Earth to translate genes into proteins. It is summarized by a 4x4x4 table which maps the 64 possible triplet RNA codons to the 20 canonical amino acids ("AAs"). Understanding the origin of this code is a fundamental open problem in biology. We review the idea of a comma-free code, and put forward a general reason to suspect the primordial code was comma-free (even though the modern code is not). We explain why this primordial code should then persist as a comma-free subcode within the modern code, and identify the five optimal candidates for such a subcode. We then introduce the idea of "compatible comma-free codes" and explain how they allow multiple codes to evolve in parallel, circumventing a standard argument suggesting that code evolution should effectively freeze when the associated genome becomes sufficiently complex. In particular, we highlight the possibility that the original code was a comma-free doublet code, which was then overtaken by a compatible comma-free triplet code, which finally evolved (after the evolution of the start codon and ribosome) to the modern saturated triplet code. To assess this idea, we classify all inequivalent compatible comma-free doublet-triplet codes and, among these, identify the three most promising predecessors of the modern code. Consistency between these three best codes and the "wobble rules" in gene translation provide non-trivial evidence for this possibility.
papers.translated_summary: 遗传密码是地球上所有当代生命用来将基因翻译为蛋白质的规则（除了一些微小的修改）。它由一个4x4x4的表格总结，该表格将64种可能的三联体RNA密码子映射到20种经典氨基酸（“AAs”）。理解这一密码的起源是生物学中一个基本的未解问题。我们回顾了无逗号密码的概念，并提出了一个普遍的理由来怀疑原始密码是无逗号的（尽管现代密码并非如此）。我们解释了为什么这一原始密码应当作为现代密码中的一个无逗号子密码而持续存在，并确定了此类子密码的五个最优候选。随后我们引入了“兼容无逗号密码”的概念，并解释了它们如何允许多个密码并行演化，从而绕开了一个标准论点，即当相关基因组变得足够复杂时，密码演化实际上应当冻结。特别地，我们强调了这样一种可能性：最初的密码是一个无逗号双联体密码，随后被一个兼容的无逗号三联体密码所取代，后者最终（在起始密码子和核糖体演化之后）演化为现代饱和三联体密码。为了评估这一想法，我们对所有不等价的兼容无逗号双联体-三联体密码进行了分类，并在其中确定了现代密码的三个最有希望的前身。这三个最佳密码与基因翻译中的“摆动规则”之间的一致性为这一可能性提供了非平凡的证据。

papers.title: Organelle intergenic DNA is preferentially distributed between opposite-polarity gene pairs.
papers.translated_title: 细胞器基因间DNA优先分布在相反极性的基因对之间。
papers.author: Sanita Lima, M.
papers.summary: Across eukaryotes, mitochondrial and plastid genomes vary enormously in size and noncoding content. This variation is often attributed to diverging mutation rates, DNA repair mechanisms, and the power of genetic drift. Although these processes can help explain how much noncoding DNA an organelle genome may retain, they do not explain how this noncoding DNA is distributed throughout the genome. We analyzed over 2.6 million intergenic regions (IGRs) from ~37,000 mitochondrial and plastid genomes to test whether gene-pair polarity marks local differences in the distribution of organelle intergenic DNA. Taxonomy-structured mixed models, controlling for flanking-gene length and type, showed that IGRs between opposite-polarity gene pairs were 1.1-3.2-fold longer than those between same-polarity genes. IGRs between convergent (+-) and divergent (-+) gene pairs showed distinct residual-dispersion patterns, indicating that they are not homogeneous in their length distribution. The prevalence of opposite-polarity gene pairs showed no consistent relationship with organelle genome size or intergenic DNA fraction. Ultimately then, gene-pair polarity consistently marks where organelle intergenic DNA is preferentially located.
papers.translated_summary: 在真核生物中，线粒体和质体基因组在大小和非编码内容上差异巨大。这种差异通常归因于突变率、DNA修复机制和遗传漂变力量的差异。尽管这些过程有助于解释细胞器基因组可能保留多少非编码DNA，但它们无法解释这些非编码DNA如何在基因组中分布。我们分析了来自约37,000个线粒体和质体基因组的超过260万个基因间区（IGRs），以检验基因对极性是否标记了细胞器基因间DNA分布的局部差异。控制侧翼基因长度和类型的分类学结构混合模型显示，相反极性基因对之间的IGRs比相同极性基因之间的IGRs长1.1-3.2倍。收敛（+-）和发散（-+）基因对之间的IGRs显示出不同的残差离散模式，表明它们的长度分布并不均匀。相反极性基因对的普遍性显示与细胞器基因组大小或基因间DNA比例没有一致关系。因此，最终，基因对极性一致地标记了细胞器基因间DNA优先定位的位置。

papers.title: Additive in size, synergistic in composition: selection across the eastern oyster larval genome under coastal acidification and sewage effluent
papers.translated_title: 在沿海酸化和污水排放条件下，东部牡蛎幼体基因组的选择：尺寸上叠加，组成上协同
papers.author: Puritz, J. B.
papers.summary: Coastal organisms experience natural and anthropogenic stressors simultaneously, yet the interactive effects of multiple stressors are largely unknown. In urbanized estuaries, coastal acidification (CA) is coupled to sewage effluent (SE): nutrient loading from SE stimulates microbial CO2 production, and this lowers the pH. The genomic targets of selection of CA and SE have been characterized separately but never together in early life stages of marine organisms. Here, we exposed eastern oyster (Crassostrea virginica) larvae to control, CA (~2800 atm pCO2), SE (5% by volume), and the combination (CASE) for 24 h across independent spawns, and used expressed exome capture sequencing to measure allele-frequency change before and after exposure, removing loci that also shifted in controls. CASE generally produced the lowest survival, although mortality was driven primarily by effluent and did not exceed the additive expectation. The size of allele-frequency change under CASE stayed close to the additive sum of the single stressors, but it showed compositional synergy: CASE had more outlier loci than CA and SE combined with 1,941 loci (747 genes) detected only under the combined treatment. CASE outliers were enriched for proteostasis, ciliary function, mitochondrial calcium handling, and a steroid-metabolizing (CYP17) module consistent with effluent endocrine disruptors. Selection acted repeatedly on standing variation across spawns and genetic backgrounds, with the largest allele-frequency shifts at rare, spawn-private loci. Enriched biological functions recurred across spawns more often than expected, while most outlier loci were specific to one or two spawns, consistent with genotypic redundancy. Our results show that combined stressors can recruit a compositionally synergistic genomic response, at loci and functions not detected under either stressor alone, even when survival and the size of allele-frequency change are additive.
papers.translated_summary: 沿海生物同时经历自然和人为压力源，但多重压力源的交互效应在很大程度上仍不清楚。在城市化河口，海岸酸化（CA）与污水排放（SE）相耦合：SE带来的营养盐负荷刺激微生物产生CO2，从而降低pH。CA和SE的选择基因组靶标已被分别表征，但从未在海洋生物早期生活阶段中同时研究。在此，我们将东部牡蛎（Crassostrea virginica）幼虫暴露于对照、CA（约2800 atm pCO2）、SE（体积比5%）及其组合（CASE）24小时，跨越独立产卵批次，并使用表达外显子组捕获测序来测量暴露前后等位基因频率变化，同时去除在对照中也发生变化的位点。CASE通常产生最低存活率，尽管死亡率主要由污水驱动，且未超过加性预期。CASE下的等位基因频率变化幅度接近单一压力源的加性总和，但表现出组成性协同：CASE的离群位点多于CA和SE之和，有1,941个位点（747个基因）仅在组合处理下被检测到。CASE离群位点富集于蛋白质稳态、纤毛功能、线粒体钙处理和类固醇代谢（CYP17）模块，后者与污水内分泌干扰物一致。选择在各产卵批次和遗传背景中反复作用于既有变异，最大的等位基因频率变化出现在稀有的、产卵批次私有的位点。富集的生物学功能在各产卵批次中重复出现的频率高于预期，而大多数离群位点特异于一个或两个产卵批次，这与基因型冗余一致。我们的结果表明，组合压力源可以招募组成性协同的基因组响应，涉及在任一单一压力源下均未检测到的位点和功能，即使存活率和等位基因频率变化幅度呈加性。

papers.title: Phylogenetic evidence for the emergence of bacterial σ-factors by domain fusion
papers.translated_title: 细菌σ因子通过结构域融合出现的系统发育证据
papers.author: Tiwary, P.
papers.summary: {sigma}-factors are dissociable subunits of RNA polymerase (RNAP), forming the basal regulatory machinery for bacterial transcription. The minimal {sigma}-factors contain two domains (called {sigma}2 or {sigma}4), both of which bind RNAP as well as the promoter DNA through their helix-turn-helix motif. Housekeeping {sigma}-factors contain four domains. We identify proteins containing at least one of the four {sigma}-factor domains in bacterial and bacteriophage genomes; we also show that proteins containing either {sigma}2 or {sigma}4, which are not defined as {sigma}-factors, are commonly found in both sets of organisms. Using phylogenetic analysis of these two domains, we suggest that the highly conserved major housekeeping {sigma}-factor, with its complex domain architecture, represents a late-evolving monophyletic clade, whereas single-domain proteins and minimal {sigma}-factor architectures comprising {sigma}2 and {sigma}4 might be ancestral. Thus, {sigma}-factors probably evolved from single-domain DNA-binding transcription factors by domain accretion.
papers.translated_summary: σ因子是可分离的RNA聚合酶亚基，构成细菌转录的基础调控机制。最小σ因子包含两个结构域（称为σ2或σ4），二者均通过其螺旋-转角-螺旋基序结合RNA聚合酶以及启动子DNA。管家σ因子包含四个结构域。我们在细菌和噬菌体基因组中鉴定出含有四个σ因子结构域中至少一个的蛋白质；我们还表明，含有σ2或σ4但未被定义为σ因子的蛋白质在这两类生物中普遍存在。通过对这两个结构域的系统发育分析，我们提出，高度保守的主要管家σ因子及其复杂的结构域架构代表了一个晚期演化的单系进化枝，而单结构域蛋白质以及由σ2和σ4组成的最小σ因子架构可能是祖先形态。因此，σ因子可能是通过结构域累加从单结构域DNA结合转录因子演化而来的。

papers.title: Gene-level evolutionary conservation and human constraint decline at comparable rates across the age of onset of Mendelian disease
papers.translated_title: 孟德尔病发病年龄跨度中基因水平进化保守性与人类约束以相近速率下降
papers.author: Mahaboob Ali, A. A.
papers.summary: Background Gene-level constraint and conservation scores are widely used to prioritise disease genes and to benchmark genomic language models. Purifying selection acts weakly on phenotypes manifesting after reproduction, so these scores are expected to carry less information about late-onset disease. An onset-dependent gradient has been demonstrated for human allele frequencies but not for the gene-level scores used in practice. Results We built an age-of-onset axis for 2,885 Mendelian diseases from Orphanet and fitted cross-species conservation (241-way phyloP) and human-population constraint (shet) on the same 5,322 gene-disease pairs against matched controls, to test whether one decays faster with onset. Their onset slopes differed by 0.23 logit units (97.5% confidence interval -0.10 to 0.56), equivalent to 0.024 units of area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) in a design resolving 0.049; the interval excludes constraint losing discriminative power faster than conservation by more than 0.011 AUROC units, widening to 0.033 when somatic associations are dropped. The usual explanation, that early-onset disease genes are developmental, pleiotropic and haploinsufficient by construction, did not account for the contrast; conditioning barely moved it. The answer did, however, depend on the constraint metric: three alternatives yielded larger contrasts excluding zero, though paired comparison could not distinguish the estimates. The metrics also diverged on recessive disease genes, with shet ranked below the gene pool (AUROC 0.487) and loss-of-function depletion above it (0.533), though, against matched controls, both ranked them below (0.457 and 0.450). Evolutionary scores improved a non-evolutionary baseline by 17 to 23%, with no onset gradient. Conclusions Conservation and constraint do not lose their value at measurably different rates as disease onset rises, and with only 283 late-onset Mendelian diseases annotated genome-wide, the question cannot be settled more finely. The gene-class explanation does not account for the contrast. Metrics that rank genes near-identically can still yield opposite onset-stratified answers, so a result reported by one metric carries a sensitivity that its confidence interval does not show. No constraint metric identifies recessive disease genes against matched controls, so a pipeline with recessive disease in scope needs a correction that switching metric does not supply.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 基因水平的约束和保守性评分被广泛用于优先筛选疾病基因以及评估基因组语言模型。纯化选择对繁殖后表现出来的表型作用较弱，因此这些评分预计对晚发性疾病携带的信息较少。已在人类等位基因频率中证明了依赖于发病年龄的梯度，但在实际使用的基因水平评分中尚未证明。结果 我们基于Orphanet为2,885种孟德尔疾病构建了发病年龄轴，并在相同的5,322个基因-疾病对上拟合了跨物种保守性（241路phyloP）和人类群体约束（shet），与匹配对照进行比较，以检验哪一个随发病年龄增长下降得更快。它们的发病年龄斜率相差0.23个logit单位（97.5%置信区间-0.10至0.56），在一个分辨率为0.049的设计中相当于受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.024个单位；该区间排除了约束比保守性更快丧失判别能力超过0.011个AUROC单位的可能性，当剔除体细胞关联后扩大到0.033。通常的解释，即早发性疾病基因在构造上具有发育性、多效性和单倍剂量不足性，并不能解释这一对比；条件化几乎未使其改变。然而，答案确实取决于约束指标：三种替代指标产生了更大的对比并排除零，尽管配对比较无法区分这些估计值。这些指标在隐性致病基因上也存在分歧，shet排名低于基因池（AUROC 0.487），而功能丧失耗竭高于基因池（0.533），不过，与匹配对照相比，两者都将其排名低于对照（0.457和0.450）。进化评分将非进化基线提高了17%至23%，且没有发病年龄梯度。结论 保守性和约束性并不会随着疾病发病年龄上升而以可测量到的不同速率丧失其价值，而且全基因组范围内仅注释了283种晚发性孟德尔疾病，这一问题无法更精细地解决。基因类别的解释不能说明这一对比。对基因排名几乎相同的指标，在按发病年龄分层时仍可能给出相反的答案，因此某一指标报告的结果带有其置信区间未显示的敏感性。没有任何约束指标能在匹配对照中识别隐性致病基因，因此若流程范围包含隐性疾病，则需要一种切换指标无法提供的校正。

papers.title: Renin, Major Adverse Cardiovascular Outcomes, and the Use of Mineralocorticoid Receptor Antagonists in Hypertension
papers.translated_title: 肾素、主要不良心血管结局以及盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂在高血压中的应用
papers.author: Tsai, C.-H.
papers.summary: Background: The prognostic significance of renin activity and its role in identifying patients who may benefit from mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) remain incompletely defined. Methods: In a multicentre retrospective cohort of 16,600 adults with hypertension, we evaluated associations between baseline plasma renin activity and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), comprising ischaemic stroke, intracranial haemorrhage, myocardial infarction, and all-cause death. Renin was analysed using restricted cubic splines and categories. Time-dependent Cox models assessed associations between MRA use and outcomes across renin strata, treating MRA exposure as time-varying. Findings: Renin showed a U-shaped association with MACE, with the lowest estimated risk at 1.17 ng/mL/h. Compared with renin 0.3-.0 ng/mL/h, both low renin (<0.3 ng/mL/h; adjusted hazard ratio [HR] 1.29, 95% CI 1.15-1.45) and high renin (>3.0 ng/mL/h; HR 1.19, 1.06-1.33) were associated with higher MACE risk. MRA use was associated with lower MACE risk when renin was low (<0.3 ng/mL/h [HR 0.59, 95% CI 0.46-0.74] and 0.3-1.0 ng/mL/h [0.71, 0.55-0.92]), but not when renin was high (>3.0 ng/mL/h [1.07, 0.76-1.52]). MRA use was associated with lower all-cause mortality across renin categories [≤]3.0 ng/mL/h, whereas no significant association was observed at renin >3.0 ng/mL/h. Interpretation: Baseline renin showed a U-shaped association with MACE. The use of MRAs was associated with lower risk of MACE only when renin was low. These findings provide support for renin-guided MRA therapy in hypertension.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：肾素活性的预后意义及其在识别可能从盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂（MRAs）中获益的患者方面的作用仍不完全明确。方法：在一个纳入16,600名高血压成人的多中心回顾性队列中，我们评估了基线血浆肾素活性与主要不良心血管事件（MACE）之间的关联，MACE包括缺血性卒中、颅内出血、心肌梗死和全因死亡。肾素采用限制性立方样条和分类进行分析。时间依赖性Cox模型评估了MRA使用与各肾素分层结局之间的关联，将MRA暴露视为时间变化变量。结果：肾素与MACE呈U型关联，估计风险最低点为1.17 ng/mL/h。与肾素0.3-3.0 ng/mL/h相比，低肾素（<0.3 ng/mL/h；校正风险比[HR] 1.29，95% CI 1.15-1.45）和高肾素（>3.0 ng/mL/h；HR 1.19，1.06-1.33）均与更高的MACE风险相关。当肾素较低时，MRA使用与较低的MACE风险相关（<0.3 ng/mL/h [HR 0.59，95% CI 0.46-0.74] 和 0.3-1.0 ng/mL/h [0.71，0.55-0.92]），但当肾素较高时则不然（>3.0 ng/mL/h [1.07，0.76-1.52]）。MRA使用与肾素分类≤3.0 ng/mL/h时较低的全因死亡率相关，而在肾素>3.0 ng/mL/h时未观察到显著关联。解读：基线肾素与MACE呈U型关联。仅当肾素较低时，MRA使用与较低的MACE风险相关。这些发现为高血压中肾素指导的MRA治疗提供了支持。

papers.title: WALK for Freezing of Gait in Parkinson's Disease: A Sham-Controlled Home Rehabilitation Trial
papers.translated_title: 帕金森病冻结步态的WALK干预：一项假对照家庭康复试验
papers.author: Benny, R.
papers.summary: Background: Freezing of gait (FOG) in Parkinson disease often persists despite dopaminergic treatment. WALK is a bilateral thigh-worn device that delivers local muscle-tendon vibration during walking. We examined whether WALK could be incorporated into supervised home rehabilitation and explored differences in freezing severity between active and sham treatment. Methods: In this single-centre pilot randomised clinical trial, adults with Parkinson disease and neurologist-confirmed FOG were assigned to Active or Sham-WALK. Both groups completed the same 16-session, six-week supervised home programme; mZ-FOG was assessed in the medication OFF state at baseline and after sessions 8 and 16. At each follow-up, assessment without the device preceded assessment with the assigned device. The complete-case analysis tested the Group X Condition interaction across the five conditions. Trial registration: Clinical Trials Registry-India, CTRI/2022/01/039256, https://ctri.nic.in/; registered 7 January 2022. Results: Ninety people were screened, 47 were randomised (active, n=27; sham, n=20), and 40 completed follow-up and entered the main analysis (active, n=24; sham, n=16). Retention was 85.1% (95% CI 74.9% to 95.4%), and all completers finished the 16-session programme. No serious device-related adverse event was reported among completers; one active-group participant discontinued because of fatigue. mZ-FOG scores decreased in both groups, but the Group X Condition interaction was not significant (F=0.847, p=0.465). At S16 before device reapplication, the baseline-adjusted active-minus-sham difference was -2.98 points (95% CI -6.63 to 0.66; p=0.106); with the assigned device, it was -2.87 points (95% CI -6.76 to 1.02; p=0.144). In the Active-WALK group, 18 of 24 improved by at least the 4.28-point MCID. Conclusion: WALK was feasible to integrate into supervised home rehabilitation and was associated with improvement in freezing across training. The lower active-group score before device reapplication at S16 suggests that improvement may have extended beyond the period of immediate stimulation.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：帕金森病中的冻结步态（FOG）尽管接受多巴胺能治疗，仍常持续存在。WALK是一种佩戴于双侧大腿的设备，在行走过程中提供局部肌肉-肌腱振动。我们考察了WALK能否纳入监督下的家庭康复，并探讨了活性治疗与假治疗之间冻结严重程度的差异。方法：在这项单中心初步随机临床试验中，患有帕金森病且经神经科医生确认存在FOG的成年人被分配至活性WALK组或假WALK组。两组均完成相同的16次、为期六周的监督下家庭方案；在基线以及第8次和第16次治疗后，于药物OFF状态下评估mZ-FOG。每次随访时，先进行不使用设备的评估，再进行使用所分配设备的评估。完整病例分析检验了五种条件下组别×条件的交互作用。试验注册：印度临床试验注册中心，CTRI/2022/01/039256，https://ctri.nic.in/；注册日期为2022年1月7日。结果：共筛查90人，47人被随机分配（活性组，n=27；假组，n=20），40人完成随访并进入主要分析（活性组，n=24；假组，n=16）。保留率为85.1%（95% CI 74.9%至95.4%），所有完成者均完成了16次方案。完成者中未报告与设备相关的严重不良事件；活性组有1名参与者因疲劳而中止。两组的mZ-FOG评分均下降，但组别×条件交互作用不显著（F=0.847，p=0.465）。在第16次治疗时、重新应用设备之前，经基线校正后的活性组减假组差异为-2.98分（95% CI -6.63至0.66；p=0.106）；使用所分配设备时，差异为-2.87分（95% CI -6.76至1.02；p=0.144）。在活性WALK组中，24人中有18人的改善至少达到4.28分的MCID。结论：WALK可可行地整合到监督下的家庭康复中，并与整个训练期间冻结的改善相关。第16次治疗时、重新应用设备之前活性组评分较低，提示改善可能超出了即时刺激期。

papers.title: A Zero-Shot Decision Model (Jev) Matches a Trained Classifier but Ranks Its Own Errors Worse: Calibrated, Split-Conformal Next-Procedure Recommendation in General Dentistry
papers.translated_title: 零样本决策模型（Jev）与训练分类器性能相当，但对其自身错误的排序更差：通用牙科中经校准的拆分共形下一操作推荐
papers.author: Rodrigues, C. C.
papers.summary: On real-world dental records, procedure history predicts the next procedure category well, and a simple history-aware classical model beats every large-language-model (LLM) design we tested. We study the question that follows every dental diagnosis: given a patients chart and most recent procedure, what should the dentist do next? Commercial dental artificial intelligence in 2026 is overwhelmingly diagnostic, and the closest published system for this sequencing task, MultiTP (Chen et al., 2024b), offers neither calibrated uncertainty, structured rationale, nor an evaluation as decision support. We introduce DentaCoPilot, a recommender that returns a calibrated top-K distribution over Current Dental Terminology (CDT) codes, a verbalised confidence label, an explicit abstain flag, and a chart-grounded rationale, and we compare four classical baselines with six LLM variants. On an apples-to-apples synthetic evaluation, classical baselines reach 0.567 top-1 while pure LLM variants trail at 0.267 to 0.467, and moving the backbone from Sonnet to Opus does not help. Prompt-conditioning a Sonnet LLM on the classical baselines candidate list closes most of the gap while preserving rationale and abstention; because the synthetic generator shares Markov structure with the bigram baseline, these synthetic rankings index pipeline behaviour, not externally valid clinical performance. We anchor external validity for the task on the public MEPS 2023 corpus (11,016 next-visit transitions across 5,088 patients): a history-aware model reaches 0.479 top-1 against 0.297 for a most-frequent baseline, is well calibrated (expected calibration error 0.031), and supports split-conformal selective prediction with a distribution-free coverage guarantee. A zero-shot LLM given only 1 this coarse history loses to the same classical baseline, so the LLMs value depends on rich charts rather than category history alone. Prospective clinician-in-the-loop validation and CDT-level real-data validation remain future work, contingent on clinical-data access and ethics approval that we have sought but not secured.

papers.title: PRE-CISE: A PRE-calibration Coverage, Identifiability, and SEnsitivity analysis workflow to streamline model calibration
papers.translated_title: PRE-CISE：一个用于简化模型校准的预校准覆盖度、可识别性和敏感性分析工作流
papers.author: Gracia, V.
papers.summary: PurposeWe introduce PRE-CISE, a pre-calibration workflow integrating coverage analysis, local sensitivity, and collinearity diagnostics to streamline model calibration. We demonstrate PRE-CISEs benefits using two testbeds (a Sick-Sicker Markov model and an SIR transmission model) and a COVID-19 case study. MethodsPRE-CISE uses coverage analysis to verify that model outputs generated from the prior distribution span calibration targets, followed by local sensitivities to quantify parameter influence, guiding the resizing of prior bounds to improve coverage. Identifiability is assessed via collinearity analysis; large indices indicate practical nonidentifiability. Bayesian calibration was used: for the testbed models (3 and 2 parameters, respectively) to match their targets; for the COVID-19 model (11 parameters) to match daily confirmed incident cases. ResultsCoverage analyses flagged initial misfits; local sensitivities identified that the Sick-to-Sicker transition probability has a greater effect on model outputs, and resizing its prior distribution bounds improved coverage. Collinearity analyses indicated that using multiple calibration targets over different time points enabled identification of all three parameters. For the SIR testbed, collinearity indices declined as target points accumulated, crossing the identifiability threshold once the data spanned the epidemic peak. In the COVID-19 model, local sensitivity analyses prioritized time-varying detection rates and contact-reduction effects, reducing the search space. Daily incident case calibration targets yielded collinearity indices below practical thresholds for all parameter combinations, whereas indices for weekly calibration targets were larger. PRE-CISE achieved greater calibration efficiency gains for denser posterior sampling and more complex models. ConclusionsPRE-CISE provides a practical, transparent pathway that helps modelers refine prior distribution bounds and calibration targets before intensive calibration, improving uncertainty reporting and strengthening the reliability of model-based health policy analyses.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 我们介绍PRE-CISE，一种整合覆盖分析、局部敏感性和共线性诊断的预校准工作流程，以简化模型校准。我们使用两个测试平台（一个Sick-Sicker马尔可夫模型和一个SIR传播模型）以及一个COVID-19案例研究来展示PRE-CISE的优势。方法 PRE-CISE使用覆盖分析来验证由先验分布生成的模型输出是否覆盖校准目标，随后进行局部敏感性分析以量化参数影响，指导重新调整先验边界以改善覆盖。可识别性通过共线性分析进行评估；较大的指数表明实际不可识别性。使用贝叶斯校准：对于测试平台模型（分别为3个和2个参数）以匹配其目标；对于COVID-19模型（11个参数）以匹配每日确诊新增病例。结果 覆盖分析标记了初始失配；局部敏感性分析确定Sick至Sicker转移概率对模型输出的影响更大，重新调整其先验分布边界改善了覆盖。共线性分析表明，使用不同时间点的多个校准目标能够识别所有三个参数。对于SIR测试平台，共线性指数随着目标点的累积而下降，一旦数据覆盖了流行病高峰，就跨过了可识别性阈值。在COVID-19模型中，局部敏感性分析优先考虑了时变检测率和接触减少效应，从而缩小了搜索空间。每日新增病例校准目标产生的共线性指数在所有参数组合中均低于实际阈值，而每周校准目标的指数更大。PRE-CISE对于更密集的后验采样和更复杂的模型实现了更大的校准效率提升。结论 PRE-CISE提供了一条实用、透明的路径，帮助建模者在密集校准之前完善先验分布边界和校准目标，改善不确定性报告并增强基于模型的卫生政策分析的可靠性。

papers.title: The lingering legacy: Resilience as a pathway linking retrospective organisational support and police retirement adjustment
papers.translated_title: 挥之不去的遗产：韧性作为连接回溯性组织支持与警察退休适应的路径
papers.author: Vaportzis, E.
papers.summary: This study evaluated retirement adjustment in UK retired police officers (N = 289) across two analytical models. The moderation model revealed a non-significant overall interaction, though exploratory Johnson-Neyman analysis identified an emergent region at 32.07 years post-retirement, where perceived organisational support significantly predicted adjustment. This suggests a long-term organisational legacy effect, wherein retrospective perceptions of service value serve as a durable psychological resource in later life. Conversely, the mediation model confirmed psychological resilience as a significant statistical mediator directly linking support to adjustment. The findings support lifelong post-service wellbeing strategies, as organisational relationships influence adjustment decades after retirement.
papers.translated_summary: 本研究通过两个分析模型评估了英国退休警察（N = 289）的退休适应情况。调节模型显示总体交互作用不显著，但探索性Johnson-Neyman分析识别出在退休后32.07年出现一个新兴区域，在该区域感知组织支持显著预测适应。这表明存在长期组织遗留效应，即对服务价值的回溯性感知在晚年作为持久的心理资源发挥作用。相反，中介模型证实心理韧性作为显著统计中介变量，直接将支持与适应联系起来。研究结果支持终身退役后福祉策略，因为组织关系在退休数十年后仍影响适应。
